# Project Maya — Technical Summary

**What it is:** An open-source local inference engine (MIT) for large MoE models on consumer PCs, serving GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, and MiniMax-M3.1-Flash via quantized GGUF/EXL3 packs, with a browser chat UI, OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs, and a live hardware monitor.

## Models & Quantization
